evals.name: bond-dirty-price-walkthrough
evals.prompt: Go step by step through the bond dirty price calculation in finstack-quant/valuations and verify each stage (settlement, schedule, accrual, discounting, clean/dirty assembly) is industry standard and correct.
evals.expected_output: Numbered step map, per-step Intent/Standard/Evidence/Verdict/Fix audits with file:line citations, cross-step contract checks, findings ordered by severity, open questions, brief summary. Fails backed by a cited convention.

evals.name: curve-bootstrap-certification
evals.prompt: Audit our OIS curve bootstrap pipeline one step at a time before we trust it for production discounting. Certify each step against market standards and flag anything nonstandard.
evals.expected_output: Step map covering instrument validation, node placement, solve, interpolation, reprice check, extrapolation; verdict per step citing algorithm-standards interpolation/bootstrap conventions; explicit check that input instruments reprice within tolerance.

evals.name: dv01-bump-path-audit
evals.prompt: Walk through how position-level DV01 is computed in finstack-quant/portfolio stage by stage and check each step does what a desk would expect (bump unit, rebuild, reprice, scaling, bucket aggregation, sign).
evals.expected_output: Step-ordered audit of the bump-and-reprice path; identifies zero-bump vs quote-bump policy and marks it Uncertain if undocumented; checks bucket sum vs parallel consistency, per-1bp scaling, sign convention, metric key format.

evals.name: swap-schedule-generation-audit
evals.prompt: Go through our swap schedule builder in finstack-quant/core one step at a time: anchor direction, unadjusted grid, stubs, business-day adjustment, accrual fractions, and fixing dates. Is each stage market standard?
evals.expected_output: Step map matching the schedule-generation template; verdict per step citing roll/stub/adjustment conventions; checks adjusted vs unadjusted accrual policy, fixing calendar vs payment calendar, and contiguity invariants (no gaps or overlaps).

evals.name: black-scholes-pricer-walkthrough
evals.prompt: Walk me step by step through the European option pricer in finstack-quant/analytics and verify each step against the standard Black/Black-Scholes formulation, including time conventions, forward construction, discounting, and edge regimes like zero vol and near expiry.
evals.expected_output: Step-ordered audit distinguishing vol time from discount time, Black (forward) vs Black-Scholes (spot) form, premium units, and edge-regime handling (zero vol to intrinsic, T->0, deep ITM/OTM without NaN); Fails cite the specific formula or convention violated.

evals.name: buggy-snippet-step-audit
evals.expected_output: Catches both planted defects: missing settlement lag (Step 1 Fail, Major) and discounting anchored at trade date instead of settlement (Fail, Major). Accrual step gets a conditional Pass attributed to the Step 1 defect, not a duplicate Fail. Fixes are concrete and note the two anchors must change together.

evals.name: monte-carlo-pipeline-certification
evals.prompt: Before we trust the Monte Carlo engine in finstack-quant/monte_carlo for exotics, certify the pipeline stage by stage: discretization, RNG and seeding, path construction, payoff evaluation, discounting, and the estimator with its error reporting.
evals.expected_output: Step map matching the Monte Carlo template; checks martingale/measure consistency (E[S_T] vs forward), reproducible seeding, correlation PSD validation, discrete vs continuous barrier monitoring, and that a standard error accompanies the price estimate.

evals.name: correct-pipeline-no-false-positives
evals.prompt: Step through the ACT/360 and ACT/365F day count implementations and the year-fraction handoff into accrual calculations in finstack-quant/core/src/dates, and confirm each step is standard.
evals.expected_output: Mostly-Pass audit with each Pass backed by a cited convention and file:line evidence, not vibes. Does not invent Fails on correct code; any Uncertain names the specific missing evidence. Cross-step section confirms consistent year-fraction units at the handoff.

evals.name: sofr-ois-swap-pricing-walkthrough
evals.prompt: Walk through how a SOFR OIS swap is priced in finstack-quant/valuations one step at a time: leg schedules, fixed accruals, compounded floating projection, curve roles, netting, and the par rate cross-check. Confirm each stage matches desk practice.
evals.expected_output: Step map matching the vanilla swap template; verifies geometric compounding of in-arrears SOFR (not simple averaging), payment lag, ACT/360 accrual, projection vs discount curve roles, pay/receive sign convention, and that NPV is approximately zero at the par rate. Fails cite the RFR convention violated; curve-role mixups are Blockers.

evals.name: vol-calibration-pipeline-audit
evals.prompt: Audit our vol surface calibration stage by stage before we ship it: target instrument selection, parameter bounds, objective function, optimizer behavior on non-convergence, fit reporting, and arbitrage checks.
evals.expected_output: Step map matching the calibration template; flags silent non-convergence or last-iterate returns as Fails, requires the objective space (price vs vol, weighting) to be documented, checks per-instrument residual reporting and butterfly/calendar arbitrage sanity on the calibrated surface.

evals.name: cds-pricer-certification
evals.prompt: Go through the CDS pricer step by step and certify each stage against ISDA standard model conventions: contract terms, hazard vs discount curve roles, premium leg with accrual-on-default, protection leg, upfront conversion, and CS01.
evals.expected_output: Step map matching the CDS template; checks IMM 20th maturity grid, standard 100/500bp coupons, ACT/360 premium accrual, accrual-on-default treatment, protection leg discounted on the risk-free curve (not hazard), 40% recovery default, and CS01 from a re-bootstrapped hazard curve per 1bp.
